description: Home fitness brand built around the SideShaper low-impact 'reverse crunch' core machine ($229-$299). Its own Collaborate page recruits influencers, bloggers, YouTubers and TikTok creators into a ShareASale-run affiliate program paying 20% per referral, with a 20% audience discount, a dedicated affiliate manager, and an 'Unlimited income potential' statement on the brand's own page - a verified-uncapped program.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Collaborate page, under 'Why partner with us?': 'Unlimited income potential: We don't set caps on the number of referrals, so the more you promote your custom link, the more you can earn.' The heading explicitly states income potential is unlimited, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped, documented transparently: the sentence ties the unlimited potential to there being no cap on referrals.

The same page: 'Earn 20% commissions per referral' and 'Earn 20% per referral. Our product sells for $229 - $299, so you'll earn an average of $52 for every sale.' The audience receives a 20% discount, assets and UGC are provided, the program managers are named (Aimee and Rakesh), and tracking/payouts run through ShareASale.

The page states the program 'is designed for high performing, value-driven platforms including influencers, bloggers, YouTubers, TikTok creators, and online businesses' - an explicitly creator-facing program, not a trade scheme.

name: SideShaper

reasons.compensation: 20% per referral on a $229-$299 product (about $52 average per sale) with an explicit 'Unlimited income potential' statement on the brand's own page - verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Two program managers are named on the page (Aimee and Rakesh), but no direct email is published, so access runs through the ShareASale sign-up.
reasons.credibility: An established single-product fitness brand with a detailed, current program page and named managers, though far smaller than the major equipment names.
reasons.niche_fit: A single demonstrable home-workout machine is ideal short-form fitness content - five-minute routines, before/after core work and low-impact training for home audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through the brand's Collaborate page into ShareASale; no follower minimum is published.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page recruits influencers, bloggers, YouTubers and TikTok creators by name and supplies professionally designed assets plus user-generated content to promote with.

description: REI Co-op, the member-owned outdoor retailer founded in 1938, sells camping, hiking, cycling, travel and outdoor apparel gear. Its affiliate program runs through AvantLink at a 5% per-sale commission reported consistently across the network's own listings and program profiles, with application review for content sites and social channels focused on outdoor recreation.

evidence.summary: Lasso's Rei Co-op program profile, fetched directly: 'Commission Rate: 5% Per Sale', 30-day cookie, $50 payout threshold, and the profile's join link routes to AvantLink - matching the 5% AvantLink consensus across outdoor affiliate directories (Niche Pursuits, LinkWhisper and Afftank all report 5% via AvantLink).

Creator Hero's in-depth review likewise reports the program is managed through AvantLink at up to 5% commission with a 15-day cookie in its table (cookie length varies by listing - 15 vs 30 days - so no cookie figure is recorded as settled). Approval requires an active site or social channel with original outdoor content; coupon-only sites are not accepted.

name: REI

reasons.compensation: 5% per sale is modest, partly offset by high average order values on premium gear (about $120 AOV reported); no published cap statement was found, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email was found on a fetched source; contact runs through the AvantLink advertiser relationship only.
reasons.credibility: A member-owned co-op operating since 1938 with tens of millions of members - as established as an outdoor retailer gets.
reasons.niche_fit: The broadest outdoor and travel-gear catalog in the directory - tents, packs, boots, apparel and travel gear give outdoor, hiking and travel creators endless review and list content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply on AvantLink, but approval is reviewed case by case and coupon/deal-aggregation sites are excluded.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running publisher program on AvantLink that accepts content sites and social channels with original outdoor content, though it is publisher-led rather than a creator-first ambassador scheme.

Its own affiliate page publishes a 13% commission on every referred sale, a 60-day cookie, and an AvantLink application, and names bloggers, review sites and influencers across Instagram, YouTube and Facebook as its ideal partners; a dedicated affiliate contact email is published on the page.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page: '13% commission for every sale you refer', a 60-day cookie duration, free US shipping and returns, and 'We've partnered with AvantLink' with the application button routing to AvantLink.

The same page: 'Our ideal partners will be content producers such as bloggers, review sites, and influencers across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other social media platforms', and it publishes the contact affiliateprogram@viakix.com for program questions. No cap statement appears on the page, so commission_cap stays unknown.

name: Viakix

reasons.compensation: 13% on every referred sale with a 60-day cookie is above the outdoor-footwear norm; no published cap statement was found, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate email (affiliateprogram@viakix.com) is published on the program page itself - direct access most brands in this round do not offer.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2015 with a real storefront and a documented give-back program, but a small single-category brand rather than a household name.
reasons.niche_fit: Comfort walking and outdoor footwear is natural travel, hiking and everyday-adventure content - fit tests, walking tours and travel packing videos.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application from the brand's own page into AvantLink, free to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits bloggers, review sites and influencers across Instagram, YouTube and Facebook, with customizable marketing materials offered to partners.

description: Made-to-order men's leather shoes, boots and accessories, handcrafted in the brand's own Bogota studio and sold direct-to-consumer in the US. The brand's own help center confirms an affiliate program paying 20% commission on first orders from new customers referred, run through Refersion, with free samples, pre-release notifications and training for affiliates.

evidence.summary: The brand's own help center FAQ, fetched directly: 'Do you have an Affiliate program? Yes, we do. As a Beckett Simonon Affiliate, you will receive a 20% commission on first orders from new customers you refer to us. Affiliates also get great perks such as free samples, pre-release notification of new products, training, tips, text, images...' - the apply link routes to beckettsimonon.refersion.com. The 20% is recorded with its basis: first orders from new customers only.

Lasso's program profile agrees on 20% per sale with a 30-day cookie, and The Affiliate Monkey's review confirms the program is hosted on Refersion with commissions processed net 30 via PayPal. Shopper's generic 5-10% Sovrn payout figure is a different resale route and was not credited as the program rate.

name: Beckett Simonon

reasons.compensation: 20% commission is at the top of men's fashion - with the honest limit that it applies to first orders from new customers only, per the brand's own FAQ. No cap statement was found.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through the brand's Refersion portal and its help center publishes a business-inquiry email (info@beckettsimonon.com), with an Affiliates Liaison named as the follow-up contact.
reasons.credibility: An established direct-to-consumer maker with its own workshop, thousands of five-star reviews per its help center, and a one-year warranty.
reasons.niche_fit: Handcrafted leather shoes and boots are core men's style content - craftsmanship stories, made-to-order explainers, styling and long-term wear reviews.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on Refersion; approval is by the brand's Affiliates Liaison rather than instant.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own FAQ confirms a working affiliate scheme with free samples, pre-release access and creative support for affiliates, though it is not a social-first ambassador program.

description: US outdoor retailer (Far & Wild LLC) selling premium outdoor clothing and gear brands for hiking, camping and travel. Its affiliate program runs on Refersion under published terms: 10% of product revenue (excluding tax and shipping), paid monthly by PayPal once earnings pass $100, open to US-based affiliates.

evidence.summary: The program's own Refersion terms of service, fetched directly: 'Commissions are 10% of product revenue which does not include sales tax and shipping charges. Commissions are paid every month.' Payments are by PayPal only and begin once an affiliate has earned more than $100; affiliates must live in the United States. The 10% is recorded with its basis: product revenue excluding tax and shipping.

The same terms describe a standard creator/publisher setup - unique affiliate codes, banners and graphics provided in a shared folder, and special tracked links - with no cap on earnings stated anywhere in the terms, so commission_cap stays unknown.

name: Far & Wild

reasons.compensation: 10% of product revenue (excluding tax and shipping) paid monthly via PayPal is solid for outdoor retail; the $100 payout threshold and the absence of any cap statement keep it mid-scored.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email appears in the fetched terms; contact runs through the Refersion program only.
reasons.credibility: A real operating outdoor retailer with full published program terms, though much smaller and less known than the national outdoor chains.
reasons.niche_fit: A curated premium outdoor catalog gives hiking, camping and travel creators branded gear to review without needing a single-brand wardrobe.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up on Refersion, but restricted to affiliates living in the United States per the program's own terms.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The published terms are publisher-style (links, banners, codes) rather than a creator-first ambassador program, so UGC evidence is thinner than the brand-direct schemes in this batch.
